basis: Recurrent dislocation of the fibular head is a structural joint disorder.

Pelvic skeletal dysplasia; no additional organ involvement established.
Ventricular tachycardia is a cardiac rhythm disorder.
Neoplasm arising from pineal parenchymal cells in an intracranial endocrine gland.
Umbrella for myeloid blood and marrow neoplasms; no additional organ damage applies across most subtypes.
Inborn immune dysregulation with defining bowel inflammation and lymphopenia; arthritis is a defining manifestation supporting musculoskeletal involvement.
Brachydactyly is a developmental skeletal abnormality affecting the digits.
Mitochondrial myopathy with defective energy metabolism, lactic acidosis and defining cognitive impairment.
Combined immunodeficiency; no specific additional organ damage established.
Carcinoma arising in breast tissue, which has no axis.
Inferior vena caval membranous obstruction is a vascular lesion causing hepatic venous outflow obstruction and congestive liver injury.
Syndrome defined by mesomelic skeletal abnormalities and ectodermal dysplasia affecting skin appendages.
Isolated developmental eye malformation with microphthalmia or anophthalmia and associated visual pathway abnormalities.
Fallopian tube inflammation is usually an ascending bacterial infection; the reproductive site itself has no axis.
Metaphyseal skeletal dysplasia; associated structural dentition abnormalities are frequent (30–79%), supporting gastrointestinal involvement.
Hypophosphatemia and hyperparathyroidism with defining rickets; hormonal renal phosphate wasting does not establish intrinsic kidney injury.
Sexual function disorder without established damage to an organ axis.
Asphyxiating short-rib thoracic dysplasia causes restricted lung development and respiratory dysfunction; renal involvement is not established for this subtype.
Tumor of pancreatic endocrine delta cells; diarrhea and steatorrhea reflect hormonal inhibition, while gallbladder disease is a separate complication.
Infertility attributable to the uterus; reproductive organs have no axis.
Benign adipose neoplasm arising in the breast; breast has no axis.
Congenital malformation of the cardiac arterial outflow tract.
Benign fibroepithelial tumor arising in breast tissue; breast has no axis.
Male infertility defined by absent sperm; no endocrine disorder or other axis involvement is inherent.
